g.title: crate The engine under `kivact`: a retained tree run in an Arvane window.
crate::a11y Accessibility tree built from the model's semantics and handed to the window.
crate::a11y::actions Carry out an assistive technology action on the node or region it targets.
crate::a11y::build Construct dirty accessibility payloads using the full builder's policy.
crate::a11y::build::dirty Expand dirt using current identity, child-order, clipping and relation metadata.
crate::a11y::build::geometry Derive semantic hierarchy and boxless bounds from retained nodes.
crate::a11y::build::identity Map engine nodes and canvas regions to native accessibility identities and back.
crate::a11y::build::node Build one node's accessibility payload under the full builder's policy.
crate::a11y::build::payload Build the payloads of payload-only dirt over the accepted identity metadata.
crate::a11y::build::relations Drop relations the published tree cannot carry.
crate::a11y::hash Fingerprint canonical accessible payloads and their transport geometry.
crate::a11y::publish Build the frame's dirty accessibility payload and submit it to the window.
crate::a11y::state Accessibility identities, accepted fingerprints and pending invalidation.
crate::a11y::text Publish native editing selections and shaped text runs.
crate::api Re-export engine handles used by the core client.
crate::check Layout check that finds texts laid out wrong from shapes the engine has.
crate::check::boxes Boxes a text is checked against: ancestors, parent, padding and clips.
crate::check::findings Apply the layout rules to a text or a subtree and collect findings.
crate::check::layout_reference Compare retained geometry and baselines with disposable fresh owners.
crate::check::lint Debug-build layout warnings for texts whose box or content changed.
crate::check::lint::changed_texts Lint the texts whose box or content changed since they were last checked.
crate::check::lint::state The lint group's state: the texts checked and their box keys.
crate::check::shaped_lines Shape a text as it is painted and read its lines' advances and ink.
crate::contract Values and callbacks exchanged by the engine and its client.
crate::contract::close Share an embedded host closure request across callback threads.
crate::contract::devtools The engine's DevTools contracts: overlays, keys, pick phases and records.
crate::contract::routed Routing metadata wrapped around shared input samples.
crate::embed Embedded hosts using the desktop client's turn and rendering loop.
crate::frame_log Opt-in frame timing log for benchmarks (`KIVACT_FRAME_LOG=<path>`).
crate::host Window loop that runs the client's turns, input and frames on demand.
crate::host::client Client callbacks, commit boundaries and thread-safe wake handles.
crate::host::devtools Host-side DevTools state: overlays, pick, keys and emulation.
crate::host::events Convert shell events and start client callbacks on the UI thread.
crate::host::launch Create the host for a client and run it in a native window.
crate::host::options Passive initial native window settings consumed by the host.
crate::host::pump Run host turns, effects, layout and frame presentation.
crate::host::testing Drive production hosts through the stepped virtual backend.
crate::host::testing::display_probe Probe the test display: GPU availability and display statistics.
crate::host::testing::self_check Run debug reference comparisons for a settled test host.
crate::host::testing::test_frame A rendered test frame: pixels, hash and PNG output.
crate::host::testing::test_host Drive a client test window and query its settled engine model.
crate::host::testing::test_options Options of a test host: fonts, window, scale and clock.
crate::host::testing::text_reference Compare normal line queries using disposable retained and rebuilt copies.
crate::host::window The host's state for one window.
crate::host::window_changes Apply window changes and finish one pump's per-window work.
crate::host::write Write and read API through which kivact changes the engine's tree in a turn.
crate::host::write::reader `Reader`: the turn's read API over the engine's trees and layout.
crate::host::write::typed The typed property table: one row per prop generates its setter and its `Prop`.
crate::host::write::writer `Writer`: the turn's write API onto the engine's models.
crate::layer Compositor layers: a node's look and the facts that decide them.
crate::lower Value lowering, resource resolution and local scene adaptation.
crate::lower::asset_event Asset diagnostics emitted while lowering scene values.
crate::lower::assets UI-local image and font resources with located failure histories.
crate::lower::border Borders, shadows and the focus ring of a box.
crate::lower::border_image CSS border-image: a source (an image, a gradient or a solid color)
crate::lower::context What painting a scene or a fill needs besides the scene itself.
crate::lower::conversion Semantic conversion of shared values to neutral text and geometry.
crate::lower::drawables The canvas drawables of a frame and their hosts' drawings, as data for lowering.
crate::lower::effects A node's effects as Arvane values: tint, group and layer reach.
crate::lower::fill Fills: background layers and CSS gradients as Arvane paints.
crate::lower::glyphs Painting of text nodes and scene text runs with their decorations.
crate::lower::input_paint Passive native editor paint facts prepared by the model for frame rendering.
crate::lower::path Transforms and offsets shared geometry for painting.
crate::lower::sanitize CSS paint correction and graceful local-command adaptation.
crate::lower::scene Flattening of node-local canvas scenes into global draw commands.
crate::lower::scene::drawable Lowering of a canvas drawable command: placed where its host draws it.
crate::lower::scene::geometry Lowering of local scene geometry commands.
crate::lower::scene::layer_effects The layer effects of CSS values (filters, masks, backdrops) and the
crate::lower::scene::layers Lowering of local scene layers commands.
crate::lower::scene::paint Paint one node's scene: reuse its cached lowering or lower each command.
crate::lower::scene::raster Lowering of local scene raster commands.
crate::lower::scene::state The groups one local scene lowering has open in the output.
crate::lower::scene::text Lowering of local scene text commands.
crate::lower::scene_cache Bounded retained local scene payloads and resource dependency data.
crate::lower::scene_out The output of one lowering: the commands of the innermost open
crate::lower::scene_shape Canvas geometry is lowered once for drawing, culling and region hits.
crate::lower::shape Box, padding box and clip path shapes shared by painting and hit testing.
crate::measure Passive leaf measurement state owned above the structural tree.
crate::measure::editor Optional native editor slot owned by Model, outside the structural tree.
crate::measure::inherited_text A node's computed text style, inherited up the tree and cached per slot.
crate::measure::input Incrementally reconcile one explicitly borrowed editor source.
crate::measure::leaf Measurement of layout leaves with Arvane's text shaping and image sizes.
crate::measure::state Slot-indexed measurement and computed-text caches, independent of topology.
crate::model The engine's models, one per window, and the App's shared state.
crate::model::aggregate The Model aggregate: every passive state group, its creation and reads.
crate::model::app_model The App's models, one per window, and the facts they share.
crate::model::apply Applies client writes and records changed derived consumers.
crate::model::changes Pending invalidation: one dirty record per node and the global flags.
crate::model::drawables Drawables in the model: mounted roots, the app's export asks, retries.
crate::model::drawables::export The exports and GPU pools of drawables, and the reconcile of their roots.
crate::model::drawables::hit Hit tests of drawables: canvas drawables and exports, in hit order.
crate::model::drawables::place Where a canvas draws each drawable: its map, clips and backface.
crate::model::drawables::request Applying the app's drawable requests (export asks and geometry) to the model.
crate::model::drawables::state Passive state of the drawables: mounted roots, the app's asks, retries.
crate::model::edit The text inputs' editing state, its index, and the IME's view of it.
crate::model::edit::ime IME composition, commit and selection applied to the focused text input.
crate::model::edit::inputs Reconcile native editors, controlled values, sessions and lines.
crate::model::edit::session The IME session of a focusable node that edits its own text.
crate::model::edit::state The edit group's state: the text input index and the IME's last text.
crate::model::events Orders host events and private post-layout commit boundaries.
crate::model::events::tests Tests of the queue's drain: the burst buffer is handed over in push order.
crate::model::focus Keyboard focus: tab stops, Tab order, focus requests and automatic moves.
crate::model::focus::navigation Focus processing: tab stops, Tab order, focus requests and automatic moves.
crate::model::focus::state Keyboard focus, held-key targets, modality and pending focus reveal.
crate::model::frame Frame clocks, frame requests, smooth scrolls and drawability.
crate::model::frame::clocks Shader clocks: which painted shaders need frames, and when the next is.
crate::model::frame::scroll_snap Settle native touch scrolling on child alignment stops.
crate::model::frame::sources The index of the props that ask for frames or layout motion.
crate::model::frame::state Own frame requests, motion clocks and smooth scroll progress.
crate::model::frame::ticks Deliver frame ticks, smooth scrolling and environment changes.
crate::model::geometry Read Model-owned layout columns through their normal geometry API.
crate::model::interact Processing that coordinates passive Model-owned groups.
crate::model::interact::caret Project the focused editor caret after scrolling its text.
crate::model::interact::geometry Lay out the node tree: window rects, overlay origins, layers, scrolls.
crate::model::interact::hit Find the node under a window point: the layers top first, then the
crate::model::interact::input_paint Prepare native editor drawing facts from a single borrowed line snapshot.
crate::model::interact::sticky Sticky boxes laid out in flow, then shifted by their scrollport's scroll.
crate::model::interact::sync Dispatches pending changes to derived work, once per commit or input.
crate::model::interact::text_geometry Native text geometry shared by layout reporting, editing and diagnostics.
crate::model::interact::visual Placement of a node's parts inside its untransformed layout box.
crate::model::keys Routing of key presses and text input to focus, editing and the client.
crate::model::layout_motion Layout interpolation through visual transforms.
crate::model::layout_motion::mailbox Record departed shared-layout boxes and hand them to arriving nodes.
crate::model::layout_motion::shared Passive state of shared layouts: the boxes of departed layout ids.
crate::model::layout_motion::state Store sparse layout interpolation runs and the boxes of departed shared layouts.
crate::model::layout_motion::steps Apply layout motion steps to shared transforms.
crate::model::lifecycle Coordinate structural slots and the Model-owned derived columns.
crate::model::modal Modal overlays that confine input, Tab order and focus to their subtree.
crate::model::modal::confinement Modal scope queries, input admission and focus confinement.
crate::model::modal::state The modal group's state: admitted pointer drags and adopted gestures.
crate::model::playback Which frame each drawn animated image shows, and when it changes.
crate::model::playback::state Passive state of the animated image playbacks, keyed by node and slot.
crate::model::playback::tick The model's steps for the animated image playbacks: sync, frame, tick.
crate::model::playback::timing Pure timing of a playback: its cycle, its frame at a time and its next change.
crate::model::pointer Pointer state machine: hover, press, capture, click, drag and wheel routing.
crate::model::pointer::hover Hover and press queries: hovered nodes, groups and the cursor.
crate::model::pointer::machine The pointer state machine: chains, press, release, move, cancel and wheel.
crate::model::pointer::shell Translation of the shell's pointer input into the pointer state machine.
crate::model::pointer::space Where one event's pointer is relative to nodes, regions and text.
crate::model::pointer::state The pointer group's state: the machine's tracks and the shell's input.
crate::model::pointer::touch Single-touch press-to-scroll arbitration over the native scroll chain.
crate::model::presence Enter and exit paint: where a node starts at mount and ends before it goes.
crate::model::presence::size Step presence size with the state transition frame clock.
crate::model::presence::state Track the size motion of node entrance and exit transitions.
crate::model::presence::transitions Start entrance transitions and run exits before a node is removed.
crate::model::recent The recent values each kind of shared node property was written with,
crate::model::scrollbar Scrollbar geometry shared by paint and pointer handling.
crate::model::semantics Semantics policy: a node's role, accessible name and assistive actions.
crate::model::state_motion Transitions of state styles; only transitioning nodes allocate them.
crate::model::state_motion::state Store running state style transitions, their tracks and color channels.
crate::model::state_motion::steps Prepare, retarget, step and shift the transitions of state styles.
crate::model::states Resolve paint and text styles for current interaction states.
crate::model::text Model's inherited text projection: the computed text style per node.
crate::model::transform Transforms and z-order that decide where a node is drawn and hit.
crate::mutation Counts client writes independently of derived model synchronization.
crate::offscreen Window-independent image output of a scene through the same painting.
crate::paint Conversion of the model's tree into an Arvane composition in paint order.
crate::paint::boxes The boxes a node's background is painted in: content, text clip and frames.
crate::paint::canvas The canvas drawables of a frame: their hosts, placements and composed layers.
crate::paint::frame_scene Build a frame's composition from the paint list, step by step.
crate::paint::list The retained, culled paint list of the nodes a frame draws in paint order.
crate::paint::list::hit_reach Answer the hit test's ink query from the paint list's kept inks.
crate::paint::list::index Child index of a container with many children for fast paint list rebuilds.
crate::paint::list::ink Ink bounds: how far a node, its text and its scene paint beyond its box.
crate::paint::list::invalidation Invalidate retained paint list entries and their recorded ink.
crate::paint::list::look A node's look as the paint list compares it: paint props and stacking.
crate::paint::list::self_check Compare retained paint order, ink and child indices with a fresh walk.
crate::paint::list::walk Rebuild the paint list by walking the tree in paint order within the view.
crate::paint::snapshot Extract and CPU rasterize a mounted subtree using the window paint pipeline.
crate::paint::state The paint group's retained paint list and derived node caches.
crate::paint::text Model-aware fill, scene and text painting orchestration.
crate::paint::text_input Render prepared native editor text, selection, caret and decoration facts.
crate::text_input A text input's lines, shaped as they are needed and kept in step with its edits.
crate::text_input::chunks Hard-line splits, chunk reconciliation and byte/scalar/UTF16 lookup.
crate::text_input::edit_lines `EditLines`: the retained, lazily shaped lines of one text input.
crate::text_input::excerpt Bounded IME excerpts cut at grapheme and CRLF boundaries.
crate::text_input::integrity Compare retained editing chunks with a full split of the displayed text.
crate::text_input::line_metrics Line height of a text style and a line's vertical offset in its row.
crate::text_input::pieces A long line shaped in pieces of under 64 KiB, joined into one line.
crate::text_input::records Passive line, chunk, cache-key and prefix records.
crate::text_input::refresh Explicit incremental reconciliation and debug integrity checkpoints.
crate::text_input::shaping Lazy shaping, editing geometry, coloring and bounded run publication.
crate::text_input::source What a text input shows, to lay its lines out from.
crate::text_measure Measures text for client drawing callbacks.
crate::tree Authoritative raw node values, stable slots and structural links.
crate::tree::child_order The sole child order, packed for layout and linked during structural writes.
crate::tree::layout_adapter Adapts the authoritative engine tree and resource measurer to layout.
crate::tree::node Raw typed node properties, scenes and direct structural queries.
crate::tree::node_tree Own retained node structure and answer ancestry and visibility queries.
crate::tree::store Slot storage of host nodes, their logical index and structural links.
